properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: certifi CA bundle: the Mozilla root store shipped with every release (pinned in requirements.txt) and used as the trust anchor for ALL outbound TLS — Electrum servers (interface.py:733), Nostr relays (nwcserver.py:208, psbt_nostr.py:101), swapserver (submarine_swaps.py:1928) via ca_path = certifi.where() (util.py:98, interface.py:74, x509.py:310). Its algorithm composition (RSA/ECDSA roots, validity periods) decides the PKI posture of the whole app.
